name: 3 D SYSTEMS CORP. Registered Sh
summary: 3 D SYSTEMS CORP. Registered Sh is a 3D printing company that provides 3D printers, materials, and services to a variety of industries, including healthcare, aerospace, and automotive. The company's solutions enable customers to create prototypes, manufacture parts, and develop new products. 3D Systems is headquartered in Rock Hill, South Carolina.
